integrity: The verifier reconstructs the exact complex from all 107 tetrahedra, proves H1 is (Z/4)^2 by unimodular integral reduction, derives exact quotient coordinates, and exhausts every three-vertex clique.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the published seventeen-vertex G6 triangulation and to simple cycles measured by edge length. The explicit Z/4 by Z/4 coordinate basis is computational rather than canonical.
title: All fifteen nonzero \(H_1\)-classes occur among triangular systoles of the seventeen-vertex flat manifold \(\mathcal G_6\)
